findings.rule_quote: No policy and claim of health insurance shall be contestable on any grounds of non-disclosure and/or misrepresentation except for established fraud, after the completion of the Moratorium Period, i.e. 60 months of continuous coverage

claim_date.quote: Petitioner submitted a Claim Form on 18 August 2022.

inception_date.quote: Policy was renewed every year till 2020 and with no-claim bonus, the insurance cover had gone up to Rs. 4,50,000/- over the period of years.

findings.question_en: For how many continuous months has this policyholder been covered, and does the insurer allege fraud?
findings.action_en: Ask the insurer to withdraw the rejection and cite the moratorium; escalate to the grievance route if refused.
